description: Boolean (checkbox/toggle) field. Minimal — no per-type extra keys observed, unlike Textarea/Number/Attachment. Its literal-comparison partner is the zero-arg false() Function node (see expression_goto_condition.json), never a Static.
notes: The captured live oracle for this type (a loop-gate field named "Done") carried no Required key at all — Required appears to default falsy when absent rather than being written explicitly on every Boolean. Safer to still set it explicitly when building new ones.

Always gate a loop/condition on a Boolean, never an optional Select: an unticked Boolean reads false (fails closed — item stays visible), a blank optional Select also reads as not-equal (fails open — item silently escapes the gate).
